props.name: orientation
props.description: How the options line up. `vertical` stacks them `--surface-gap-sm` apart, and joins `CheckboxItem` rows into one card with a line between rows. `horizontal` wraps them in a row `--surface-gap-lg` apart, and each `CheckboxItem` row is a card of its own. props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected values. The group decides which members with a `value` are checked, so their own `checked` and `defaultChecked` have no effect.

props.name: children
props.description: The row's content: `CheckboxItem.Content` with a `Title` and a `Description`, then `CheckboxItem.Actions`. Direct `CheckboxItem.SubSection` children render below the label row, outside the label, so a field or button in one never toggles the row. A server component may write these children and pass them to a client component that renders the `CheckboxItem`. In a client component, a Fragment or wrapper around a SubSection hides it from the row and keeps it inside the label.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the row. A `px-*` utility sets the card's side inset, and a click in that inset beside the label row toggles the checkbox. The row paints the card fill (`bg-card`), and a background class such as `bg-background` replaces it. The row states its fill as `--surface`, the colour a chart's cut-outs paint, so a row that paints another opaque fill restates `--surface` and `--surface-muted-foreground` beside it, such as `className="bg-background [--surface:var(--background)] [--surface-muted-foreground:var(--muted-foreground)]"`. The checked row's `bg-muted` tint and the disabled row's `--selection-disabled-background` fill win over such a class. Set `--selection-disabled-background`, for example to `var(--background)`, to change the disabled fill. The edges and the lines between rows come from the `--selection-*` theme roles, which the Tokens section lists. Set a role on the element that carries the theme attributes, `<html>` or a `ThemeScope`. For example, `--selection-border: var(--border)` on the `ThemeScope` gives branded rows an outer edge. On a plain wrapper the rows keep the edges the theme element resolved.

props.name: controlPosition
props.description: Where the checkbox sits in the row: before the content, or after it at `end`.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables the checkbox, which dims to 50%, and shows the disabled row. The row fills with the theme's `--selection-disabled-background` under `--selection-disabled-hatch` stripes, and shows the `not-allowed` cursor. Neutral themes stripe a muted fill, and branded themes keep the card fill with no stripes. The row's text, its SubSection's included, takes `--selection-disabled-foreground`, which is the muted foreground in branded themes. A text colour class on the row still wins. A disabled group shows its rows the same way.

props.name: isReadOnly
props.description: Makes the checkbox read-only: it shows its state but a click does not change it.

props.name: isSubSectionSelectable
props.description: Lets a click on a SubSection's text, band or side padding toggle the checkbox, while links, buttons, fields and other focusable elements in it keep their own clicks. The checkbox's name stays the label row. Leave it off when the SubSection reveals fields under the checkbox, so a click between those fields does not clear the choice.
